anchors.citation: Higham, Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms, 2nd ed., SIAM, 2002
anchors.role: conditioning, finite precision, forward/backward error and stability

anchors.citation: IEEE Standard for Floating-Point Arithmetic, IEEE 754-2019
anchors.role: arithmetic formats, operations and exception semantics

anchors.citation: On Taylor Model Based Integration of ODEs, SIAM Journal on Numerical Analysis
anchors.role: verified ODE integration, interval bounds and overestimation limits

anchors.citation: Fast and Rigorous Arbitrary-Precision Computation of Gauss-Legendre Quadrature Nodes and Weights, SIAM JSC
anchors.role: rigorous numerical enclosures and implementation evidence

anchors.citation: NASA-STD-7009B, Standard for Models and Simulations
anchors.role: model/simulation lifecycle credibility, V&V and UQ

dependence_notes: Higham and later numerical sources share the numerical-analysis tradition but address different validity levels.
IEEE 754 standardizes arithmetic behavior; it does not establish algorithm or model adequacy.
Validated numerics examples prove bounded mathematical statements for encoded problems, not target-world validity.

anchors.citation: Chen, Cheung and Yiu, Metamorphic Testing: A New Approach for Generating Next Test Cases
anchors.role: original metamorphic-testing formulation for absent or impractical oracles

anchors.citation: How Effectively Does Metamorphic Testing Alleviate the Oracle Problem?, IEEE TSE 40, 4-22
anchors.role: empirical adequacy and relation-identification evidence

anchors.citation: Testing and Validating Machine Learning Classifiers by Metamorphic Testing, Journal of Systems and Software
anchors.role: ML scientific-software application and oracle limitations

anchors.citation: Verification and Validation of Bioinformatics Software without a Gold Standard, BMC Bioinformatics
anchors.role: naturalistic scientific-software oracle case

dependence_notes: The sources share the metamorphic-testing lineage and are not independent demonstrations of universal adequacy.
Metamorphic relations are necessary properties, not complete specifications, unless completeness is separately shown.

anchors.citation: Upper and Lower Probabilities Induced by a Multivalued Mapping
anchors.role: upper/lower probability and information combination foundation

anchors.citation: A Mathematical Theory of Evidence, Princeton University Press
anchors.role: belief-function/evidence-theory parent

anchors.citation: Statistical Reasoning with Imprecise Probabilities
anchors.role: coherent lower previsions and partial ignorance

anchors.citation: Towards a Unified Theory of Imprecise Probability, International Journal of Approximate Reasoning
anchors.role: comparison and limitations of uncertainty models

dependence_notes: These sources are historically and conceptually related rather than independent competing confirmations.
Different formalisms have different conditioning, independence and decision semantics and cannot be merged by labels.

anchors.citation: Background Knowledge in Ontology Matching: A Survey
anchors.role: semantic heterogeneity, incomplete context and external background knowledge

anchors.citation: Pass H reconstruction of boundary objects and epistemic cultures
anchors.role: local projections and prohibited cross-practice inferences

dependence_notes: Ontology matching and boundary-object traditions approach interoperability from computational and sociological directions; their convergence is structural, not identity.

anchors.citation: The FAIR Guiding Principles for Scientific Data Management and Stewardship
anchors.role: findability, accessibility, interoperability, reuse and machine actionability

anchors.citation: The CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance
anchors.role: collective benefit, authority to control, responsibility and ethics

anchors.citation: Operationalizing the CARE and FAIR Principles for Indigenous Data Futures
anchors.role: operational interaction of machine-oriented stewardship and rights/governance

dependence_notes: CARE publications share community and author networks; they are authoritative practice/governance sources, not independent empirical proof of every implementation effect.
FAIR and CARE answer different questions and must not be scored on one axis.

anchors.citation: Epistemic Injustice: Power and the Ethics of Knowing, Oxford University Press
anchors.role: testimonial and hermeneutical injustice

anchors.citation: Feminist Epistemology and Philosophy of Science, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
anchors.role: situated knowledge, standpoint, plural critical objectivity and social power

anchors.citation: Co-Creating and Implementing Quality Criteria for Citizen Science
anchors.role: co-created contextual quality criteria and transparent implementation

anchors.citation: Going with the Flow? Using Participatory Action Research in Physical Geography
anchors.role: participation from question definition through outcomes

dependence_notes: Philosophical, participatory and citizen-science sources provide different evidence types and should not be pooled as one empirical effect.
Participation quality remains context-dependent and requires negative controls.

anchors.citation: Underspecification Presents Challenges for Credibility in Modern Machine Learning, JMLR 23
anchors.role: equally scoring pipelines with divergent deployment behavior

anchors.citation: Data Cascades in High-Stakes AI, CHI 2021
anchors.role: compounding downstream data-work failures

anchors.citation: Weak Baselines and Reporting Biases Lead to Overoptimism in ML for Fluid-Related PDEs
anchors.role: strong numerical baselines, resource/accuracy matching and selective reporting

anchors.citation: Data Leakage Inflates Prediction Performance in Connectome-Based ML Models
anchors.role: pipeline leakage and inflated held-out performance

dependence_notes: The studies cover different domains and failure mechanisms, but all concern the credibility of the pipeline rather than isolated model architecture.
The PDE review is domain-specific and does not imply the same weak-baseline rate elsewhere.
